main_measure.name: pooled mean 5-bar excess return (vs window hold average) after top-quintile forecast bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 and supporting check holds; reject if t <= -2; inconclusive otherwise or if < 30 pooled top-quintile cases or < 8 per coin

supporting_check.name: coins with top-quintile minus neutral excess > 0 (need >= 2)

decided_by: Inconclusive: t lies between -2 and 2, or t >= 2 but the supporting check (positive in at least 2 coins) fails.
reading: Top quintile is forecast >= the 80th percentile of each coin's non-zero forecasts over all its windows, the hold baseline is the mean of all 5-bar forward returns in the same window, and with only the coins present the supporting check still requires at least 2 positive coins.
